thesis: The episode argues that the traditional search model is dying and being replaced by AI-driven shopping, creating a clear divergence between companies. It posits that Amazon is a 'polluted' search engine incentivized to sell low-quality goods and ignore bogus reviews, whereas Costco is presented as a superior, 'AI-proof' trust-based model that refuses to sell bad items to protect its membership value.
